description: Create CRM database migration, update TypeScript types, and build complete CRM workflow service layer (src/services/crm/) with lead lifecycle, deal pipeline, conversion workflows, activities, follow-ups, and lead scoring.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/005_crm_workflows.sql with: lead_scores table, followup_rules table, email_sequences table, email_sequence_steps table, ALTER leads to add score + last_scored_at columns, ALTER deals to add converted_from_lead_id + sales_order_id columns, seed default followup rules, all indexes, and RLS policies as specified in the requirements.

Update src/types/database.ts: Add LeadScore, FollowUpRule, EmailSequence, EmailSequenceStep interfaces. Update Lead interface to include score (number|null) and last_scored_at (string|null). Update Deal interface to include converted_from_lead_id (string|null) and sales_order_id (string|null).

Create src/services/crm/types.ts with CRM workflow types: CreateLeadInput, UpdateLeadStatusInput, ConvertLeadToCustomerInput, ConvertLeadToDealInput, CreateDealInput, AdvanceDealStageInput, CloseDealInput, CreateActivityInput, CompleteActivityInput, ScheduleFollowUpInput, SnoozeFollowUpInput, LeadScoreBreakdown, FollowUpAutoConfig, and any other types needed by the services.

Create src/services/crm/scoring.ts with: calculateLeadScore() (scoring 0-100 based on source, estimated_value, engagement activities count, recency of last activity, company size from notes), scoreAllLeads() (bulk recalculate all active leads), getHotLeads() (leads score > 70). Each function uses supabase client directly.

Create src/services/crm/leads.ts with: createLead() (creates with auto-score), updateLeadStatus() (validates transitions), convertLeadToDeal() (creates deal linked to lead), convertLeadToCustomer() (direct conversion for won leads), getLeadTimeline() (all activities for a lead), bulkAssignLeads() (reassign multiple).

Create src/services/crm/deals.ts with: createDeal() (from lead or standalone), advanceDealStage() (validate stage transitions), closeDeal() (mark won/lost with reason, update timestamps), getDealTimeline() (stage changes + activities), calculatePipelineValue() (weighted: value x probability).

Create src/services/crm/conversion.ts with: convertLeadToCustomer() full workflow (create customer from lead data, update lead.converted_customer_id, set lead status won, create activity log, return new customer), convertDealToOrder() (create draft sales order linked to customer, update deal.won_at, create activity, return draft order).

Create src/services/crm/activities.ts with: createActivity() (linked to customer/lead/deal), completeActivity() (mark done + optional follow-up), getUpcomingActivities() (due today or overdue sorted by priority), getActivityFeed() (paginated timeline with entity details), bulkCompleteActivities().

Create src/services/crm/followups.ts with: scheduleFollowUp() (create follow-up activity with scheduled_at), getOverdueFollowUps() (past due date, not completed), getFollowUpsByUser(), autoScheduleFollowUp() (rules-based: 2 days after status change, 5 days after proposal, 1 day after meeting, 7-day stall reminder), snoozeFollowUp() (reschedule to later date).
Create src/services/crm/index.ts barrel export of all service functions and types.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/005_crm_workflows.sql exists with all required tables, columns, seeds, indexes, and RLS policies
src/types/database.ts has LeadScore, FollowUpRule, EmailSequence, EmailSequenceStep interfaces and updated Lead/Deal types
src/services/crm/ has all 7 files (index.ts, types.ts, leads.ts, deals.ts, conversion.ts, activities.ts, followups.ts, scoring.ts)
All service functions use the supabase client from @/lib/supabase
bun run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/stockflow-inventory-crm && bun run build' and confirm successful build with no TypeScript errors
